wineries.name: Lenton Brae
wineries.specialty: Cabernet Sauvignon and Chardonnay from a heritage-listed rammed-earth winery
wines: Wilyabrup Cabernet Sauvignon Malbec Petit Verdot
wineries.description: A heritage-listed rammed-earth winery in the Wilyabrup hills where architect-founded bones meet quietly classical Cabernet and Chardonnay.
wineries.story: Lenton Brae began in 1982 as a retirement project for Perth architect Bruce Tomlinson, who designed and built its rammed-earth winery himself; the building is now heritage-listed by the Shire of Busselton. The first vintage arrived in 1987 from plantings of Cabernet Sauvignon, Semillon and Chardonnay, and by 1990 the estate had won two trophies, including wine of the show, at the SGIO WA Winemakers exhibition. James Halliday has long rated it five stars for elegant wines in classic Margaret River style.

image.alt: Inside Lenton Brae's rammed-earth cellar door, with a central wood fire, bentwood chairs and wine shelves set into arched alcoves
image.verified: downloaded 2026-07-10, shows the tasting room interior: rammed-earth walls, arched niches, fireplace and deli counter

briefing.icebreaker: Is it true the founder was an architect who built this rammed-earth winery himself as a retirement project?
briefing.proMove: Book the small-group tasting through their Rezdy page (from $10, about 45 minutes) and add a build-your-own cheese and charcuterie platter from the deli counter.
briefing.hiddenGem: The winery building is heritage-listed by the Shire of Busselton, a rare civic honour for a working cellar door.

wineries.sommNote: One of Wilyabrup's founding names: come for the heritage rammed-earth room, stay for Cabernet built along quietly classical lines.
wineries.visitorSummary: Family-run warmth is the constant: dogs playing with the wine dogs, build-your-own cheeseboards from the little deli, and afternoons that swallow whole days.

wineries.name: Fermoy Estate
wineries.specialty: Reserve Cabernet Sauvignon and Chardonnay from gravel loam beside the Wilyabrup Brook
wineries.description: A quietly brilliant Wilyabrup estate whose Reserve Cabernet took Best in Show at the Decanter World Wine Awards, from vines a mere 4.5km from the Indian Ocean.
wineries.story: Fermoy Estate was first planted in 1985 on gravel loam over clay beside the Wilyabrup Brook, with 14 hectares of vines sitting just 4.5 kilometres from the Indian Ocean. Senior winemaker Jeremy Hodgson and vineyard manager Andy Keig have worked side by side since 2014, and their 2020 Reserve Cabernet Sauvignon was named Best in Show at the 2024 Decanter World Wine Awards, an honour reserved for the top 50 of more than 18,000 wines. The team keeps things low-key: cover crops, fewer tractor passes and a less-is-more hand in the vineyard.

image.alt: Aerial view over Fermoy Estate's vineyard rows at golden hour, with a dam and stands of eucalypts beyond
image.verified: downloaded 2026-07-10, shows sunlit aerial of estate vine rows, dam and surrounding bushland

briefing.icebreaker: What changed in the vineyard in the lead-up to the 2020 Reserve Cabernet winning Best in Show at Decanter?
briefing.proMove: Walk-ins are welcome but book ahead for a seated tasting; the $15 fee covers up to five wines and is redeemable against any purchase.
briefing.hiddenGem: The estate sleeps guests too: The Lodge, a four-bedroom homestead among the vines, can be booked for the full winery-stay experience.

wineries.sommNote: Wilyabrup's quiet achiever: the Reserve Cabernet that beat 18,000 wines at Decanter still pours at an unhurried cellar door.
wineries.visitorSummary: Hosts are thanked by name in nearly every review; dogs are welcomed, the sparkling trio has a devoted following, and late walk-ins report being looked after anyway.

gallery.alt: A golden-hour grazing table with Fermoy Cabernet and Chardonnay
gallery.verified: downloaded 2026-07-12, viewed and verified from the estate’s own site

wineries.name: Juniper Estate
wineries.specialty: Cabernet Sauvignon and Chardonnay off 1973 plantings beside the Wilyabrup Brook
wineries.description: A cottage-garden cellar door on Tom Cullity Drive pouring wines from one of Wilyabrup's founding vineyards, planted back in 1973.
wineries.story: Henry and Maureen Wright planted this Wilyabrup vineyard in 1973, making it one of the region's founding sites, before Roger Hill and Gillian Anderson created Juniper Estate around it in 1998. The cosy cellar door sits between the original vines and the Wilyabrup Brook, ringed by cottage gardens and peppermint trees. The flagship Tribute comes off Block 7 of those first plantings: hand-picked, single-block Cabernet Sauvignon.

image.alt: Juniper's stone entrance sign wrapped in flowering grevillea, with the red-gravel drive leading into the vineyard
image.verified: downloaded 2026-07-10, shows the estate entrance, drive and vine rows beyond

briefing.icebreaker: Is it true The Tribute comes off Block 7 of the original vines planted here in 1973?
briefing.proMove: Bookings via their SimplyBook page are preferred but you can drop in; weekends open an hour earlier at 10am, and ask about the cellared museum wines alongside the current release.
briefing.hiddenGem: In summer the estate hosts monthly Woodfired Pizza Sundowners on the lawn, and you're welcome to bring your own picnic to spread under the peppermint trees.

wineries.sommNote: Fifty-year-old Wilyabrup vines, a $10 tasting and museum bottles on pour: quietly one of the best-value stops on Tom Cullity Drive.

wineries.name: Gralyn Estate
wineries.specialty: Old-vine Reserve Cabernet and rare barrel-aged fortifieds from 1975 plantings
wineries.description: A family estate on Caves Road pouring old-vine Cabernet and world-beating fortifieds, still gloriously free of a tasting fee.
wineries.story: Graham and Merilyn Hutton turned their Wilyabrup beef farm to vines in 1975 and opened Margaret River's first cellar door in 1978, the year of their first vintage. Today their daughter Annette Baxter and her husband Scott run the estate, making around 3,000 cases a year with a cult following for barrel-aged fortifieds: the Artizan Rare Muscat was named Wine of the Year at the 2022 London Wine Competition. The wines are sold exclusively at the cellar door and through their own shop.

image.alt: Gralyn Estate's glass-fronted cellar door under a brooding sky, flanked by a stacked-stone sculpture, gnarled old vines and a towering palm
image.verified: downloaded 2026-07-10, shows the cellar door building, lawn, sculpture and old vine rows

briefing.icebreaker: You opened Margaret River's first cellar door in 1978 — what's changed on Caves Road since?
briefing.proMove: Standard tastings are free and walk-in, but book the ninety-minute premium experience with Scott and Annette to finish inside the original 1978 Gralyn Cellars, normally closed to the public.
briefing.hiddenGem: The Artizan Rare Muscat beat the world to be crowned Wine of the Year at the 2022 London Wine Competition, and you can only buy it here.

wineries.sommNote: The region's fortified whisperers: come for 1975-vine Cabernet, leave clutching a half-bottle of Rare Muscat you'll ration for years.
wineries.visitorSummary: Free, generous tastings of genuinely rare wines; reviewers who visited ten wineries in a day repeatedly crown this one, and anniversary pilgrimages are a theme.

wineries.name: Thompson Estate
wineries.specialty: Specialist-range Cabernet and Chardonnay from a cardiologist-founded, Halliday five-star estate
wineries.description: A Halliday five-red-star estate on Tom Cullity Drive founded by a Perth cardiologist, tasted in the rustic charm of the barrel room.
wineries.story: Cardiologist Peter Thompson and his wife Jane bought this Wilyabrup property in 1994, planting Chardonnay and Pinot in 1997 and Cabernet the following year. The Four Chambers range nods both to the heart and to the four stages of winemaking: viticulture, vinification, maturation and presentation. A state-of-the-art on-property winery crushed its first vintage in 2009, and James Halliday has rated the estate five red stars year after year.

image.alt: Aerial view of Thompson Estate's netted vine rows, winery buildings and dam ringed by marri forest
image.verified: downloaded 2026-07-10, shows aerial of vineyard blocks, winery and lake

briefing.icebreaker: The founder is a cardiologist — is that why the Four Chambers range is named for the heart?
briefing.proMove: Cellar door runs Tuesday to Saturday only; book two days ahead by phone or email, and pay the extra $5 to taste The Specialist range. Fees are refunded on purchase.
briefing.hiddenGem: You can bring a picnic, buy a glass from $10 and wander the sculpture walk on the lawn; the winery itself only arrived on-site in 2009.

wineries.sommNote: Precision runs in the family here: cardiologist-founded, Halliday five-star, and The Specialist Cabernet is the steady heartbeat of the range.

wines.name: Wilyabrup Cabernet Sauvignon Malbec Petit Verdot
wines.description: The estate flagship: Wilyabrup Cabernet given a Bordelais wink with Malbec and Petit Verdot in support.
wines.sommNote: Decant for an hour and serve at 17C; the Malbec plushness sits over a classically firm Wilyabrup tannin line.

wines.name: Wilyabrup Chardonnay
wines.description: Single-subregion Chardonnay in the taut, grapefruit-and-flint Margaret River idiom.
wines.sommNote: Give it ten minutes out of the ice bucket; the struck-match top note unfurls into white peach.

wines.name: Southside Chardonnay
wines.description: The early-drinking Chardonnay: bright, lightly oaked and unapologetically moreish.
wines.sommNote: Their crowd-pleaser by the fire at cellar door; serve well chilled with anything from the deli counter.

wines.name: Reserve Cabernet Sauvignon
wines.description: The Decanter Best in Show 2024 winner: 18 months in tight-grained French oak and pure Wilyabrup gravel-soil pedigree.
wines.sommNote: Cellar-release poise; decant 60 to 90 minutes and let the cassis and cedar uncoil slowly.

wines.name: Reserve Chardonnay
wines.description: Fermoy's top white: maritime-cooled Wilyabrup Chardonnay with precision to match its polish.
wines.sommNote: Serve at 10 to 12C, not fridge-cold; the sea-spray salinity is the whole point.

wines.name: Chardonnay
wines.description: The estate Chardonnay: bright orchard fruit with a maritime line of acidity.
wines.sommNote: The smart buy of the range; drinks beautifully now with anything from the grazing menu.

wines.name: The Tribute
wines.description: Single-block Cabernet from Block 7 of the 1973 plantings, hand-picked and made only in worthy years.
wines.sommNote: Old-vine Wilyabrup Cabernet at full stretch; decant generously and give it protein-rich company.

wines.name: Cornerstone Wilyabrup Cabernet Sauvignon
wines.description: The estate's cornerstone indeed: structured, gravelly Cabernet from the home vineyard's oldest rows.
wines.sommNote: Classic dusty Wilyabrup tannin; cellar five years or decant an hour and serve with lamb.

wines.name: Cornerstone Wilyabrup Chardonnay
wines.description: Plush yet precise single-vineyard Chardonnay that earned 97 points from critic Jeni Port.
wines.sommNote: Nine months in French oak and just 12.5% alcohol; poised enough for shellfish, plush enough for poultry.

wines.name: Reserve Cabernet Sauvignon
wines.description: Old-vine Wilyabrup Cabernet from the original 1975 plantings, sold only from the estate.
wines.sommNote: Dense, dark-berried and built to keep; the museum vertical at cellar door shows how gracefully it goes the distance.

wines.name: Artizan Rare Muscat
wines.description: The 375mL barrel-aged fortified that took Wine of the Year at the 2022 London Wine Competition.
wines.sommNote: Serve a thimbleful slightly cool with dark chocolate or blue cheese; decades of barrel age in every sip.

wines.name: Reserve Chardonnay
wines.description: Small-make estate Chardonnay with the same cellar-door-only exclusivity as the reds.
wines.sommNote: Generous, barrel-worked style; let it warm a touch and it fans out beautifully.

wines.name: The Specialist Cabernet Sauvignon
wines.description: The estate's top Cabernet, made only from the best barrels in the best years.
wines.sommNote: Taut Wilyabrup cassis and fine gravelly tannin; decant an hour and it opens like a textbook.

wines.name: Estate Chardonnay
wines.description: Estate-grown Chardonnay from vines first planted in 1997, in the crisp modern Margaret River mould.
wines.sommNote: Grapefruit pith and gentle cashew oak; a natural with anything pulled from the Indian Ocean.

wines.name: Estate Cabernet Sauvignon
wines.description: The estate's calling-card Cabernet: classic Wilyabrup structure without the Specialist price tag.
wines.sommNote: Drinks well young with a short decant, but rewards five patient years in the rack.
